definitions.explanation: tickets or items sold before an event or official release date, usually at a lower price

examples.japanese: {前売|まえう}りチケットを{買|か}う。
{前売|まえう}りは{当日|とうじつ}より500{円|えん}{安|やす}い。
examples.english: Advance tickets are 500 yen cheaper than same-day tickets.

examples.japanese: {前売|まえう}り{開始|かいし}と{同時|どうじ}にチケットが{売|う}り{切|き}れた。
examples.english: Tickets sold out as soon as advance sales started.

notes:
FORMS:
{前|まえ} (before) + {売|う}り (selling)
- {前売|まえう}りする (to sell in advance)

PRICING:
{前売|まえう}り tickets are typically cheaper than {当日券|とうじつけん} (same-day tickets), encouraging early purchase and helping organizers estimate attendance.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {前売|まえう}りチケット / {前売券|ぜんばいけん} (advance ticket)
- {前売|まえう}り{開始|かいし} (start of advance sales)
- {前売|まえう}り{期間|きかん} (advance sale period)
- {前売|まえう}り{価格|かかく} (advance sale price)

ALTERNATE READING:
{前売|ぜんばい} is used in compounds like {前売券|ぜんばいけん}.

RELATED WORDS:
- {当日券|とうじつけん} (same-day ticket - antonym)
- {予約|よやく} (reservation)
- {先行販売|せんこうはんばい} (priority/early sale)
